book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Ruuka

content: Yɨɨsu ararumana na Zaakayo
Neho Yɨɨsu akasikɨra mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨriko, akabha arahɨta kʉzɨnzɨra zʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo.
Mʉrʉbhɨri muyo, kwarɨ nu umuniibhi wʉmwɨ, iriina ryazɨ Zaakayo, aarɨ ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa abharihya bha rigʉʉti.
Aarɨ areenda korora Yɨɨsu nɨ‑mʉʉtʉ wa teemwakɨ, nawe ataaturirɨ komorora, kʉ kʉbha kwarɨ ni iribhita ikʉrʉ rya abhaatʉ, na aarɨ muguhɨ.
Kʉgayo akaryara mwega, embere wa riribhita riyo, akatiira kʉmʉtɨ gwo omoko, korereke atʉrɨ korora Yɨɨsu aarɨ arahɨta kʉnzɨra yiyo.
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aahikirɨ hayo, akarora kʉmʉtɨ igʉrʉ, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Zaakayo, ika bhwangʉ! Ɨranyenda nɨbhɨ umugini yɨɨka waazʉ reero.”
Rogendo rʉmwɨ Zaakayo akiika, akaginihya Yɨɨsu yɨɨka waazɨ kwa bhozomerwa.
Hanʉ abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhaarʉʉzɨ gayo, bhakatanga kwibheerya, bharabhuga, “Ndora agiirɨ kurya na wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ!”
Nawe, Zaakayo akiimɨɨrɨra, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, itegeerera! Nangʉ ritɨnɨka rye ebhegero bhyanɨ nɨrabhaha abhahabhɨ. Na arɨɨbhɨ niruushiryɨ mʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi, nɨramʉgarukirya manga kane.”
Yɨɨsu akabhuga, “Reero yɨnʉ, ubhutuuribhwa bhuhikirɨ munyumba yɨnʉ. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ wʉʉsi, ni‑wi ikishoko cha Abhurahaamu,
kʉ kʉbha Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ izirɨ komohya na kʉsabhʉra abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhabhurirɨ.”
Ekerenjo cha bhambʉʉsa bhanʉ bhaahɨɨrwɨ zimpirya

Hanʉ abhaatʉ bhaarɨ bhakɨɨrɨ bhariitegeerera amangʼana gayo, Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra ekerenjo kɨmwɨ, kʉ kʉbha aarɨ ariisemera Yɨrusarɨɨmu, na abhaatʉ bhayo bhakakina kʉbha ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu bhʉrarorekana ribhaga riyo.

Kʉgayo, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Kwarɨ nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ wi ikishoko chɨ ɨkɨtɨmi. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo, akakora orogendo kuja icharʉ cha kore, korereke asʉngʼaanɨ ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwʉ ʉkʉbha ʉmʉtɨmi, akʉmara agarʉkɨ kotema mucharʉ chazɨ.
“Hanʉ aarɨ akɨɨrɨ kuja, akabhabhɨrɨkɨra bhambʉʉsa ikumi gatɨ wa bhambʉʉsa bhaazɨ, akabhaha bhʉʉsi endengo kʉrʉ ya zimpirya za mina,
akabhabhʉʉrɨra, ‘Mokore ubhusuruja na zimpirya zɨnʉ kuhika ribhaga nɨraagarʉkɨ.’
“Nawe abhaatʉ bhi icharʉ chazɨ bhakamwigatanɨra bhʉkʉngʼu ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo. Bhakatʉma abhaatʉ bhajɨ bhabhabhʉʉrɨrɨ, ‘Tʉtakwenda ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ, abhɨ mʉtɨmi wɨɨtʉ!’
Nʉʉrʉbhu, akahaabhwa ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi. Akʉmara akagarʉka, akabhabhɨrɨkɨra bhambʉʉsa bhanʉ aahɨɨrɨ zimpirya, korereke bhambʉʉsa bhʉʉsi bhabhʉʉrɨrɨ ʉmʉtɨmi abhwɨnɨ bhwerakɨ.
“Mbʉʉsa we embere akahika, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, kuzimpirya zɨnʉ wantigiirɨ, nibhwɨnɨ omoheero manga ikumi.’
“Ʉmʉtɨmi wuyo akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Mbʉʉsa waanɨ ʉmʉzʉmu, ʉkʉrirɨ bhwaheene! Kʉ kʉbha waarɨ moheene kʉmahocha amasuuhu, nɨrakoha ʉbhʉkʉrʉ igʉrʉ wi imijɨ ikumi.’
“Mbʉʉsa wa kabhɨrɨ wʉʉsi akahika, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, kuzimpirya zɨnʉ wantigiirɨ, nibhwɨnɨ omoheero manga kataanʉ.’
“Ʉmʉtɨmi akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Na naawɨ, nɨrakoha ʉbhʉkʉrʉ igʉrʉ wi imijɨ ɨtaanʉ.’
“Mbʉʉsa ʉwʉndɨ akahika, akabhuga, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, zimpirya zaazʉ nzɨnʉ hanʉ. Nɨkazibhisa mʉkɨtambaara, korereke zɨtabhʉra.
Nɨkakorabhu kʉ kʉbha nɨkakwʉbhaha, awɨ nɨ‑mʉʉtʉ mʉhaari. Ʉhaagega bhɨnʉ ʉtatɨɨrɨ, na ʉhaagesa bhɨnʉ ʉtahambirɨ.’

“Ʉmʉtɨmi akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Awɨ, nɨ‑mbʉʉsa mʉbhɨ! Nangʉ nɨrakʉtɨnɨra kʉrɨngʼaana na amangʼana gaazʉ aumwene. Ʉkabhuga wɨɨzɨ inyɨ nɨ‑mʉʉtʉ mʉhaari, nɨhaagega bhɨnʉ nɨtatɨɨrɨ, na nɨhaagesa bhɨnʉ nɨtaahambirɨ.
Angabhɨɨrɨ nɨmbu nɨrɨ, kwakɨ ʉtantɨɨrɨɨrɨ zimpirya zaanɨ kʉbhasuruja, korereke hanʉ naarɨ nɨkʉgarʉka ɨwaanɨ, naarɨ nɨragega nzaru kʉkɨraho?’
“Rogendo rʉmwɨ, akabhabhʉʉrɨra abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhiimiiriirɨ hayo, ‘Gega zimpirya za wuyo, momohe wʉnʉ abhwɨnɨ omoheero manga ikumi.’
“Bhakamʉbhʉʉrɨra, ‘Nawe ʉmʉkʉrʉ, wʉnʉ amarirɨ kobhona omoheero gwa manga ikumi!’

“Akabhuga, ‘Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akokorera emeremo rɨnʉ nɨmʉhɨɨrɨ, nɨramwongereerera. Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ atakokora emeremo amasuuhu ganʉ nɨmʉhɨɨrɨ, nʉʉrʉ ikisuuhu kɨnʉ anachʉ, nɨramuruusha.
Hamwɨmwɨ na gayo, abhabhisa bhaanɨ bhanʉ bhatɨɨndirɨ inyɨ nɨbhɨ ʉmʉtɨmi waabhʉ, mʉbhareete hanʉ, mubhiitɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwanɨ!’ ”
Yɨɨsu arasʉngʼaanwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu ncha Masiya
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aamarirɨ kʉgamba gayo, akakangatɨra riribhita kuja Yɨrusarɨɨmu.
Hanʉ iisɨmɨɨrɨ mʉzɨmbɨri za Bhɨtifagɨ na Bhɨtaniya, kʉkɨgʉrʉ kɨnʉ kikubhirikirwa Ɨmɨzɨyituuni, akabhatʉma abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhabhɨrɨ.
Akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Mujɨ mʉrʉbhɨri rʉnʉ rore embere waanyu. Hanʉ mʉraasikɨra muyo, mʉrabhona umwana wɨ ɨtɨkɨrɨ abhʉhirwɨ wʉnʉ akɨɨrɨ kogega mʉʉtʉ. Mʉmʉtazʉrɨ, momoreete hanʉ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi araabhabhuuryɨ, ‘Ndora mʉramʉtazʉra?’ Mʉmʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ aramwenda.’ ”
Akʉmara, abhɨɨga bhayo bhakaja, bhakabhona bhyʉsi bhyarɨ chɨmbu Yɨɨsu aabhabhuuriirɨ.
Hanʉ bhaarɨ bharatazʉra umwana wɨ ɨtɨkɨrɨ, abheene bhakabhuurya, “Ndora mʉratazʉra umwana wɨ ɨtɨkɨrɨ wuyo?”
Bhakabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aramwenda.”
Bhakahirɨra Yɨɨsu, bhakaara zengebho zaabhʉ igʉrʉ waazɨ, bhakatiirya Yɨɨsu kʉtɨkɨrɨ akaja.
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aarɨ araja, abhaatʉ bhakabha bharaara zengebho zaabhʉ kʉnzɨra kwa kʉmʉsʉʉka.

Na hanʉ iisɨmɨɨrɨ umuhiringitʉ gwɨ ɨkɨgʉrʉ chɨ Ɨmɨzɨyituuni, riribhita ryʉsi rya bhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakatanga kukumya Mungu kwa bhozomerwa, igʉrʉ wɨ ɨbhɨsɨgʉ bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ bhaarʉʉzɨ. Bhakatiirya amaraka gaabhʉ,
bharabhuga,

content.text: “Anʉ ʉrʉbhangʉ ʉmʉtɨmi wʉnʉ akuuza kuriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ!
Kʉbhɨ no omorembe gatɨ wa Mungu na abhaatʉ bhaazɨ!

content: Kwiribhita riyo, bhaarɨmu Abhafarisaayo. Bhakabhʉʉrɨra Yɨɨsu, “Umwija, ʉbhakiryɨ abhɨɨga bhaazʉ!”
Yɨɨsu akabhuga, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, bhanʉ bharaakirɨ, amabhwɨ garatiirya riraka!”
Yɨɨsu ararɨrɨra Yɨrusarɨɨmu
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu iisɨmɨɨrɨ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu na kororora, akarʉrɨrɨra.
Akabhuga, “Angabhɨɨrɨ omenye reero nʉʉrʉ amangʼana ganʉ gakoreeta omorembe! Nawe nangʉ gabhisirwɨ ʉtakʉtʉra kʉgarora.
Kuzisikʉ zɨnʉ zikuuza, abhabhisa bhaazʉ bhariinaarya inyiki, bhatʉrɨ kʉbhanyahaara mbaara zʉʉsi.
Akʉmara, bharakuricha awɨ na abhaatʉ bhaazʉ bhʉʉsi. Rɨtareeho ibhwɨ rɨnʉ rɨkʉsaaga igʉrʉ wɨ ɨrɨndɨ, kʉ kʉbha ʉtaamɨnyirɨ ribhaga rɨnʉ Mungu akuuza kʉkʉsabhʉra!”
Yɨɨsu araheebha abhasuruja mwihekaaru
Yɨɨsu akasikɨra mwihekaaru, akatanga koheebha abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhakugurya ebhegero muyo.
Akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, ‘Inyumba yaanɨ, ɨrabha inyumba ya amasabhi.’
Nawe imwɨ, mʉyɨkʉrirɨ kʉbha ribhigi rya abhasaakuri.”
Sikʉ zʉʉsi, Yɨɨsu aarɨ arabhiija abhaatʉ mwihekaaru. Abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani, abhiija bhi imigirʉ na abhakaruka bha Abhayaahudi, bhaarɨ bharamohya ɨnzɨra yu ukumwita,
nawe bhatabhwɨnɨ umweya, kʉ kʉbha abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhaarɨ bhariitegeerera amangʼana gaazɨ bhʉkʉngʼu.

footnotes.text: Mina ni‑zimpirya zi Ikigiriki, na mina yɨmwɨ yaarɨ irihi ryo omohocha kumyɨri ɨtatʉ zisikʉ zirya.
